entries: And how did you manage to survive?
It is a simple story really... because I do not remember any of those details.
故事其实很简单……因为那些细节我一件都不记得了。
I cannot help but find this highly suspicious.
我实在忍不住觉得，这非常可疑。
At last! It is good to see someone with flesh on their bones.
总算！见到一个骨头上还长着肉的人，真好。
How is it that you are inside of a locked crypt?
你是怎么进到一座锁着的墓室里的？
Please, allow me to introduce myself. My name is...
The last thing I remember is coming here with a friend.
我记得的最后一件是，我和一位朋友来到了这里。
I am so lost. Please, allow me to accompany you. I will lend my hammer to your cause.
我迷失太久。请让我随你同行。我会为你的目标挥动我的锤子。
Your story is not unlike that of myself and my companions.
你的遭遇，和我和同伴们的不无相似。
I do not know what has become of my friend, nor can I remember their face.
我不知道我的朋友遭遇了什么，连面孔都想不起来了。
I do hope you change your mind. I will remain here a while longer.
希望你能改变主意。我会在这里再待一阵子。
It looks like you do not have any room for me. Please let me know if that changes.
看来你们没有位置带上我。若是情况有变，请告诉我一声。
There were so many horrible creatures... we tried to leave but the door had been locked behind us.
有那么多可怕的怪物……我们想离开，可大门在我们身后被锁上了。
